service.description: One delivery of an event to a recipient by a channel and template (MessageDelivery): an existing one for the same four is answered and nothing is queued again. The source (a MessageDeliverySource whose enumCode is its build service) makes the message's parameters at each attempt. A transactional notice needs no marketing consent; another needs its purpose granted when it is handed off. sendNow tries it at once, in its own transaction.

parameter.name: organizationPartyId
parameter.description: The organization the delivery is from, whose suppressions it meets (empty: its store's, when it names one)

parameter.name: sendingProfileId
parameter.description: The sending profile it goes out from (impl-marketing P6): its relay, sender, reply-to and VERP bounce address, within its throttle and quiet hours; of the organization given (its own when none is)

parameter.name: consentContactListId
parameter.description: A topic's list (Commerce P9 follow-up: a store's review requests): the purpose is then the recipient's latest consent of it on this list, not their consent as a whole

parameter.name: consentOrganizationPartyId
parameter.description: With consentContactListId (impl-marketing P9: a Marketing send's recipient): the topic's consent within this organization, Marketing's evidenced rule (the purpose's global or organization row withdrawn, the list row withdrawn or the address's solicitation refused blocks; a granted list or purpose row admits) at each attempt

parameter.name: consentContactMechId
parameter.description: The address the topic's consent is read for (P9)

parameter.name: bodyParameters
parameter.description: For a source with no build service: the template's parameters, kept with the delivery (never a secret)

service.description: One attempt of a queued or retrying delivery, under its lock: its source builds the message, the consent is snapshotted, a suppressed destination is refused (impl-marketing P3: the delivery suppressed, nothing handed off; a hard bounce for every delivery, another block for a promotional one only), send#EmailTemplate hands it off, and its outcome is recorded (sent; retryable, again later; permanent, failed; anything else uncertain, kept for review). Another state is left as it is.

A provider's later report of a delivery's last hand-off (a delivery report, a bounce): its outcome recorded as an attempt's is (messageId sent; deliveryOutcome retryable, permanent, or anything else uncertain, kept for review).

A source's retry of a delivery it sent (impl-sales P10: a quote send to a recipient that failed): a failed or waiting delivery queued again from now, in a transaction of its own; a sent, suppressed or uncertain one is left as it is (an uncertain send is reviewed, never repeated blindly). The caller attempts it once its own transaction commits.
requeue#Delivery's step, under the delivery's lock in the transaction requeue#Delivery starts.
The run_MessageDeliveries job: the queued and retrying deliveries that are due, oldest first, each in its own transaction; an uncertain one is never tried again here.

A reviewer's decision on an uncertain delivery: sent (the provider shows it went out), failed, or retry. Needs MESSAGE_DELIVERY_REVIEW (ADMIN's, and Marketing's dispatchers' through BossSetupMarketingData, impl-marketing P9) and, but for a system administrator, a delivery of an organization the reviewer works for (the delivery's own, else its store's; another's, or one of no organization, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Keeps who resolved it, when and the note (resolvedByUserId, resolvedDate, resolutionNote).

Which of the given EmailMessages are an attempt of a delivery of this ledger: each with its delivery (ownerRef), the delivery's state in words, whether its uncertain send may be reconciled now (the last attempt of an uncertain delivery) and whether the ledger tries it again on its own (queued or waiting). The ledger offers no retry. No address or parameter of a delivery is returned.

The reconciliation of an uncertain delivery by its last attempt's message, as resolve#Delivery: sent (the provider shows it went out), or notSent (the ledger tries it again itself). A retry is refused (OWNER_RETRIES: the ledger's own run tries a waiting delivery again). Answers a refusal, never an error, for a caller without MESSAGE_DELIVERY_REVIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED) and for a delivery that is not uncertain or an earlier attempt's message (NOT_UNCERTAIN).

The suppressions the caller may read, newest first, filtered in the query: channel, reason, organization, state (active, the default; ended; all) and text (part of the address, for a reader who sees addresses); a page at a time (suppressionList with its page fields). A holder of MESSAGE_SUPPRESSION_REVIEW or CONTACT_ADMIN reads every block; a Marketing audience reader or configurer the blocks of every organization and of the organizations of their scope, another organization's left out. The address is masked for a reader who is no reviewer, contact administrator or audience reader. Each row: channel, destination, organization, reason, source, evidence, dates, state and whether the caller may end it; canAdd and canEnd for the caller. Refuses a caller who reads none (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

parameter.name: everyOrganization
parameter.description: Whether the caller may add a block for every organization

parameter.name: organizationOptions
parameter.description: The organizations the caller may add a block for, {value, label}

service.description: Adds a suppression (action add, the default) or ends one (action end). Add: a destination of a channel (an email address, kept trimmed and in lower case), the organization it is for (empty: every organization, a reviewer's, contact administrator's or the bounce intake's alone; a Marketing audience editor names an organization of their scope), its reason (MessageSuppressionReason, staff by default), source (MessageSuppressionSource, staff for a user) and evidence (required); an active block of the same destination, organization and reason is answered (created false), never doubled. End: a holder of MESSAGE_SUPPRESSION_REVIEW alone, with new evidence (required); the row stays with its source and the reviewer's evidence. A subscription never ends a suppression. A hard bounce stops every delivery of the ledger to the address; any other reason promotional deliveries only, never a transactional notice (the user's call, Nov 14). A block's own fromDate and thruDate are a reviewer's or the bounce intake's (a run with no user); anyone else's starts now and has no end. Refuses PERMISSION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_DENIED, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, DESTINATION_INVALID, CHANNEL_INVALID, VALUE_INVALID, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE and ALREADY_ENDED.

Internal: which of the destinations of a channel are suppressed now for an organization (its own blocks and every organization's), with each one's reason; the ledger's attempt and the audience services ask it. For a transactional delivery (transactional true) only a block that stops every delivery, a hard bounce; a complaint or staff block stops promotional deliveries only (the user's call, Nov 14). No permission.

The templates the caller reads (MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_VIEW or MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_EDIT; the organizations they work for, every internal one for a system administrator or a holder of MARKETING_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS), by name, filtered in the query by organization, channel, purpose, locale, text and state (active, the default; ended; all), a page at a time. Each row: name, organization, channel, purpose, locale, state (draft, scheduled, published, ended) with the date in effect and the subject, whether it has a draft, its revision and whether the caller may edit it. Refuses PERMISSION_DENIED and ORGANIZATION_DENIED.

One template the caller reads: its header, its draft and the content in effect (each with its subject, preheader, body, text, declared variables and revision), and its published contents newest first (dates, reason, who published). Another organization's answers RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.

A template of an organization the caller works for (MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_EDIT): a name, the channel (email), the purpose (MessageTemplatePurpose: promotional or transactional) and a locale, with its EmailTemplate (MT_ and its id, sent through SYSTEM unless a sending profile names its relay and sender). Copied from another template the caller reads (copyFromTemplateId), it starts with that one's content as an unpublished draft. Refuses PERMISSION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_DENIED, NAME_REQUIRED, CHANNEL_INVALID, VALUE_INVALID and RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.

A template's header (name, purpose, locale) at the revision read (expectedRevision: its lastUpdatedStamp in millis; STALE_RECORD naming the current one). MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_EDIT; refuses TEMPLATE_ENDED.

The template's draft, written at the revision read (the draft's, else the template's for a first draft or one made from the content in effect); a published content is never changed (F78). The subject (one line), preheader, body (HTML) and text alternative may name only the variables the content declares, as ${name} (variables: a list of {name, label, fallback, required}); refused when stored: an undeclared name (UNDECLARED_VARIABLE), an expression or an unclosed ${ (VARIABLE_EXPRESSION), a template tag (TEMPLATE_DIRECTIVE), a variable inside a link's address (VARIABLE_IN_LINK), a script, frame, form, embedded object, event handler or script link (UNSAFE_HTML), a reserved or repeated name (VARIABLE_INVALID). Each store writes the body as a dbresource:// .html.fancy-locked file (the text a .fancy-locked one) of its own. MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_EDIT; refuses TEMPLATE_ENDED, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_RECORD.

A content (the draft, else the one in effect, or contentSeqId) rendered with sample values (sampleValues: synthetic, never a recipient's data), each declared variable its value or else its fallback, through the locked renderer: the subject, preheader, body and text; the required variables with neither (missingVariables) and the findings (an empty or long subject, no body, no text alternative). Reads only (MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_VIEW); refuses NO_CONTENT.

parameter.name: safeBody
parameter.description: The rendered body cleaned as an allow-html="safe" parameter is, for a screen

service.description: The draft takes effect at fromDate (now when empty; never in the past), with a reason, at the draft's revision: its texts are checked again (a subject and a body required), and the content in effect at that date ends there; a content already scheduled on or after it refuses SCHEDULE_CONFLICT. Publication authorizes no send and changes no prepared message. MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_EDIT; refuses NO_DRAFT, REASON_REQUIRED, DATE_INVALID, SUBJECT_REQUIRED, BODY_REQUIRED, STALE_RECORD.

The template is no longer offered from now, with a reason, at its revision; its content in effect ends and its contents stay. MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_EDIT; refuses TEMPLATE_ENDED, REASON_REQUIRED, STALE_RECORD.

The ledger's template source (MdsrcMessageTemplate): a delivery of a template's EmailTemplate rendered from the content in effect at the attempt with the delivery's queued values (bodyParameters at queue#Delivery) for its declared variables only; suppress when the template ended, has no content in effect, or a required variable has no value or fallback. Internal.

The sending profiles the caller reads (MESSAGE_SENDING_CONFIGURE, MARKETING_CONFIGURE, MARKETING_SEND_EDIT or MARKETING_DISPATCH; the organizations they work for), by name, filtered by organization, channel and state (active, the default; all), each with its relay's id, sender, purpose, limits, tracking and its readiness now; never a host or credential. Refuses PERMISSION_DENIED and ORGANIZATION_DENIED.

parameter.name: relayOptions
parameter.description: For a configurer: the relays Admin approved, by id

parameter.name: numberOptions
parameter.description: P22, for a configurer: the organizations' messaging numbers an SMS profile may be bound to

service.description: One sending profile the caller reads with its readiness checks, and for a configurer the relays Admin approved to choose from (EmailServers no mail account owns, by id). Another organization's answers RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.

A new sending profile of an organization the caller works for, or one changed at the revision read (expectedRevision): a name; the relay, one Admin approved (an EmailServer no mail account owns: RELAY_INVALID); the sender and reply-to (ADDRESS_INVALID); the purpose; a throttle of messages an hour; quiet hours (HH:mm, both or neither) and their time zone; the tracking policy; the bounce domain (DOMAIN_INVALID); the PASS site of its unsubscribes; dates. MESSAGE_SENDING_CONFIGURE; refuses PERMISSION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_DENIED, NAME_REQUIRED, VALUE_INVALID, DATE_INVALID, STALE_RECORD.

parameter.name: fromPhoneNumber
parameter.description: P22, an SMS profile (channelEnumId MdcSms): one of the organization's messaging numbers (NUMBER_INVALID); it has no relay, sender or bounce domain

parameter.name: segmentCost
parameter.description: P22: an SMS profile's cost of one segment, for the estimate

service.description: The readiness of one sending profile now (design §12 SenderReadiness): in effect; the transport (the relay there, not a mail account's, not disabled, with a host, its last Admin test not failed); the sender and its domain (one this server signs, or a relay that passed its test); the bounce account (a hosted or shared mail account bounces@ the bounce domain, which receives bounces+(delivery).(key)@ it); the unsubscribe page (the site's Account Email preferences, else the server's own). Each check: checkKey, title, state (ready, warning, blocked), message and the place that fixes it (fixRoute: marketingSendingProfiles, adminMailRelay, mailAccount); ready when none is blocked, with the reasons. With refresh, a configurer's check is kept as the profile's last. No host or credential is told.

One message read as a delivery report and applied once (design §15.1): a DSN or an abuse report (ARF) a bounce account received (another mailbox's message is left alone, nothing recorded: notBounceAccount), read with the framework's read#DeliveryReport, its delivery found by the VERP address bounces+(deliveryId).(bounceKey)@ (the address it came to, an ARF's Original-Mail-From) only with the delivery's random key, or the returned message's Message-ID; a DSN counts only the recipients that are the delivery's address (another's is ignored); or a template's sent message the edge relay marked ES_BOUNCED, by the attempt that sent it (F76). A permanent failure or the edge's bounce is a hard bounce, a transient failure or a delay a soft bounce, a delivery a delivered fact, an abuse report a complaint: each a receipt fact of the delivery once (MessageDeliveryReceipt), the delivery's strongest fact never moved back. A hard bounce adds one suppression of the address for every organization, a complaint one for the delivery's organization, never doubled; a soft bounce suppresses nothing. Each message once (MessageDeliveryReport): read again it changes nothing (duplicate). An unknown key or an unreadable report is recorded, logged and left in its mailbox. Internal.

parameter.name: notBounceAccount
parameter.description: True for a message no bounce account received: left alone, nothing recorded

service.description: The run_DeliveryReports job: the messages of the bounce accounts (bounces@ a sending profile's bounce domain) and the template messages the edge marked bounced in the last 30 days that were not read, or failed with tries left (five), each in its own transaction; a failure is logged and the rest go on.

The EmailMessage ECA DeliveryReportEdgeBounce: a template's sent message turning ES_BOUNCED (the edge relay's bounce) is read by process#DeliveryReport after the write commits, in a transaction of its own; never fails the write.

A delivery's receipt facts (delivered, soft bounce, hard bounce, complaint, each once, with its date and detail) and the reports read for it, beside its hand-off state, for MESSAGE_DELIVERY_REVIEW, MESSAGE_SUPPRESSION_REVIEW or a contact administrator (every delivery for a system administrator; else the deliveries of the organizations they work for, every internal one with MARKETING_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS; another's RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); no address (one in a diagnostic shows as [address]).
